title: Hearty Weeknight Croatian Lardons Wrap
description: A hearty, earthy, and comforting Croatian-inspired dish featuring hoisin sauce, lardons-render, and crispy onions wrapped in a ti-leaf-wrap. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the lardons and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onions to the pan and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Mince the garlic and add it to the pan, cooking for 1 minute.
Add the hoisin sauce, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan, stirring to combine.
Warm the ti leaf wraps in the microwave or oven.
Assemble the wraps by spooning the lardons and onion mixture onto the center of each wrap, followed by a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Repeat with the remaining wraps and filling.
